newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman trims Unilever.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman trims Unilever.

text.p: Earnings estimates for Unilever Plc were trimmed at Lehman Brothers ahead of an expected weak set of third-quarter results on Friday, a research note from analyst Richard Newboult at the brokerage said on Wednesday.
For 1996, Lehman trimmed its earnings per share estimate for the UK arm of the consumer products giant by 3.7 percent to 82.07p. For the Dutch arm it lowered it by 3.2 percent to 14.24 guilders.

Lehman repeated an "underperform" rating on the stock and said it expected a 0.7 percent decline in Q3 pre-tax profit at constant exchange rates to 781 million stg, at the low end of a range between 760 million stg and 820 million.

Newboult said part of the drop was due to an exceptional charge of around 74 million stg, while its trading performance was likely to be depressed by a drop in profits from ice cream sales which account for about 30 percent of profits in Europe.
Reflecting the strength of sterling, Lehman also cut its 1997 earnings per share estimate for the UK group by 3.0 percent to 90.67p but raised the Dutch estimate 1.6 percent to 16.29 guilders.
